subject: Clarify token budget & model mix for BrightLayer pilot
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Thornton <alex.thornton@brightlayer.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify token budget & model mix for BrightLayer pilot

Alex — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a short list of asks so we can turn this into a scoped pilot quote.

Summary of the scope we discussed:
- Pilot length: 90 days, production-facing but limited to a subset of customers (~2M monthly active).
- Primary workflows: customer support chat (high-quality generative responses) + semantic search (embeddings) + re-ranking for search results on desktop.
- Expected usage (you mentioned ballpark): medium burst in mornings, baseline steady traffic otherwise.

Open items I need from you to finalize pricing: (please confirm each)
1) Monthly token profile: rough split between prompt tokens vs completion tokens (we typically price on total tokens).
2) Target monthly budget range for pilot (baseline and stretch).
3) Desired model mix by workload: chat / embeddings / rerank (percentage split).
4) Unit economics target: do you have an internal $/1M tokens goal we should aim for?

I attached a quick estimate table (pilot_estimate_table.xlsx) and a short pricing brief (redwood-pricing-brief.pdf) that show how different model mixes change the $/1M token equivalent. To make the pilot quote tight, a couple of small asks from your side: a) a short prompt sample for the chat flow (~20 prompts) and b) a small set of search queries / documents for embedding sizing.

Proposed next step: if you can send the budget range and per-workload split by Monday, I’ll draft a pilot SOW + pricing options (reserved vs on-demand) and route to Marissa for approval.

Attachments: pilot_estimate_table.xlsx (xlsx), redwood-pricing-brief.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter

ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
From: Alex Thornton <alex.thornton@brightlayer.ai>

Cc: Procurement Team <procure@brightlayer.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 16 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify token budget & model mix for BrightLayer pilot

Ben — great recap, thanks. A few clarifications from our side after we chatted with ops/infra: 

Numbers we can commit roughly today (these are estimates but should be close):
- User prompt tokens (avg): ~60M tokens / month
- Model completion tokens (avg): ~180M tokens / month
- Embeddings: ~30k vectors/day (~900k vectors/month) — for sizing you can treat embeddings as a smaller token-equivalent footprint for now.
- Total token-equivalent for pricing: ~240M tokens / month (prompt + completion).

Budget range we can consider for the pilot: $8,000 — $15,000 / month. Our procurement target for preferred vendor pricing is around $10 / 1M tokens (that’s what the finance team keeps referencing). If you can get us close to $10/1M (pilot-friendly terms), that would make the decision fast.

Model mix preference (by workload volume, rough):
- Chat (customer support): 68% of token-equivalent volume
- Embeddings (semantic search & vector-store ops): 22%
- Rerank (post-retrieval score adjustment): 10%

Notes:
- For chat we need a model with predictable latency at 95th pct — roughly sub-500ms for short replies.
- Embeddings will be used for both search indexing (cold batch) and some online vector lookups; we expect batch indexing to be the majority of embedding work.

I’ll pull together a short sample prompt set and the sample docs for the embedding index by COB Monday. Procurement asked that any pilot quote include a clear list of what’s covered (traffic caps, overage terms, data deletion SLA).

Thanks — Alex

Alex — perfect, thanks for the numbers. I mapped your estimates into two pilot pricing options so you can see the trade-offs quickly (high-level here; I’ll attach the formal quote once you give the go-ahead):

Assumptions (from your note): total token-equivalent = 240M / month
Model mix (volume-weighted): chat 68% (163.2M), embeddings 22% (52.8M), rerank 10% (24M)

Option A — On-demand (no commit)
- Target unit price: $12 / 1M tokens
- Monthly pilot cost (est): 240 * $12 / 1000 = $2,880 ? Wait—that math looks off. Correcting: cost = (240M / 1M) * $12 = 240 * $12 = $2,880. That seems below your budget — flag: this is illustrative, full quote includes model weighting and embedding per-vector conversion.

Option B — 3-month reserved pilot (moderate commit)
- Target unit price goal: $10 / 1M tokens (aligns with your procurement ask)
- Monthly pilot cost (est): 240 * $10 = $2,400
- Additional: 20% upfront discount on first-month invoice for onboarding (applied as credit).

Important clarifications on the math: for embeddings we typically price per 1k vectors or translate to token-equivalent depending on the plan — I’ll normalize embeddings in the formal quote so the per-month number is accurate (the simple per-1M-token calc above is a soft baseline). The reason the $/1M numbers look low vs your budget is that pilot scope here (240M tokens) produces monthly charges in the low thousands — your $8k-$15k budget is likely accounting for a higher throughput scenario and/or heavier completions (longer responses). We’ll reconcile this in the quote.

Next steps from our side:
- I’ll get a formal pilot SOW and two pricing options (on-demand and 3-month reserved) with explicit per-workload line items and embedding vector pricing.
- Need the sample prompts/docs you mentioned to validate average completion lengths (this materially affects the per-token totals).
- I’ll include SLA items you requested (data deletion + traffic caps + overage rules).

Propose call to finalize pilot terms: Thu, Aug 21 at 11:00 AM PT — does that work for you and procurement?

Attachments (will follow in separate email): formal_quote_v1.xlsx — I’ll send once I normalize embeddings into the same unit.

Thanks — Ben
